test_policy.notes: IU Bloomington is test-optional: applicants choose whether SAT, ACT or CLT scores are considered, though the university encourages sharing them. Scores received by Jan 15 can still count for scholarship consideration.

requirements.notes: Apply IU application or Common App (no preference). An essay is required on either platform (Apply IU: IU-specific essay of 200-400 words). Fee shown on the freshman application page; the international page lists no separate fee.

deadlines.label: Early action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Highest admission and scholarship consideration; response by Jan 15 for complete applications.

deadlines.label: Regular decision
deadlines.notes: Also the deadline for international-student merit scholarships (Global Engagement). After Feb 1 applications are considered only if space is available.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Scores must be from within the last two years. Also accepted: SAT EBRW 560, ACT English 21; AP/IB/A-Level English results; citizenship of or 3 years of secondary school in a listed English-speaking country; IU Intensive English Program level 7. After admission, a second (higher) level is needed to skip English support courses (e.g. TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.5, Duolingo 130, PTE 68, SAT EBRW 710, ACT English 32), otherwise sub-scores decide placement.

english.notes: Admission minimum (old 0-120 scale). The page gives no new 1-6 scale minimum.

aid.notes: International students are eligible for IU merit scholarships (judged from the admission application, deadline Nov 1 for IU scholarships, Feb 1 for international-student merit awards) and some country-specific awards. They cannot use US federal loans. The pages do not describe need-based institutional aid for international freshmen.

toefl.note: Code stated on the English-proficiency page (in its graduate-student paragraph) as IU Bloomington's TOEFL code.

tier_notes.business: Kelley School of Business is a top-15 undergraduate business program.
tier_notes.arts_design: Jacobs School of Music is one of the top US music schools.
tier_notes.engineering: Only Intelligent Systems Engineering (in the Luddy School); no traditional engineering college.
